posts.trend: Furniture rental in India: why young Indians are choosing to rent
posts.context: Urban millennials increasingly rent furniture due to career mobility and high housing costs.
posts.angle: Buying permanent furniture requires an optimism about staying in one pin code that nobody under 35 possesses.
slides: "Beta, teak wood sofa kyun nahi lete? Lifetime chalega."

"Uncle, next month team restructuring hai."
"Landlord non-vegetarian food allow nahi karta."

posts.caption: Every family has an uncle who treats rented furniture as personal moral failure.
posts.rank_verdict: The landing explains the underlying premise instead of introducing a punchy new beat.
